title: CYBRIK internal service-delegation request (validation view) v1
description: The relying-party validation view of an internal service-to-service call presenting a W2-F delegation token (ADR-0008). It binds the decoded token to the mTLS transport context (E2) and to the advisory request body the relying party MUST cross-check: the body's tenant/org/operation/marking are NEVER trusted over the token, and the token is NEVER trusted over the mTLS peer certificate. additionalProperties:false makes a static bearer, forwarded end-user token, or inline credential structurally impossible. This is a validation contract, not a wire endpoint; it declares no server, host, or route. $id uses the RFC 2606 .example documentation domain. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA). Accepted at Gate W2-F (Codex under Founder delegation, 2026-07-24).

request_id.description: Caller-assigned logical request id (e.g. 'svc_…'). Correlates the presented token → the relying party's authorization decision → audit.

presented_token.description: The decoded delegation token presented on this call. Signature/JWKS verification and the RFC 8725 strict iss/aud/exp/nbf/jti checks happen BEFORE these body cross-checks; a token that fails either is rejected without consulting the body.

relying_party.description: The validating service's own trust context for this call. The relying party compares token.aud to `audience` (confused-deputy defense) and the mTLS peer certificate thumbprint to token.cnf['x5t#S256'] (proof-of-possession). Both mismatches MUST be rejected.

peer_cert_thumbprint.description: SHA-256 thumbprint of the presented mTLS client certificate (E2). MUST equal token.claims.cnf['x5t#S256']; a mismatch means a token replayed without its bound key and MUST be rejected.

tenant_id.description: Advisory body tenant. MUST equal token.claims['cybrik.tenant_id']; the relying party derives authoritative tenant from the token/credential and rejects a mismatch (cross-tenant guard).

org_scope.description: Advisory body org hint. When present it MUST equal token.claims['cybrik.org_scope']; it carries no authority on its own (ADR-0007 org delta PROPOSED — NOT APPLIED).

actor.description: Advisory body actor; authoritative actor is token.claims['cybrik.actor']. Present only for audit correlation.

operation.description: The operation the body requests. operation.name MUST equal token.claims['cybrik.operation'].name; a body requesting an operation the token did not authorize is a confused-deputy attempt and MUST be rejected.

data_marking.description: The marking of the data this call would touch. MUST be at or below token.claims['cybrik.marking'] on the classification/TLP lattice; a request above it is a marking escalation and MUST be rejected (runtime).

correlation.description: Optional trace correlation. Carries no authority.
